prior_findings.COMPARISON-1: Static repair present: central comparison_output prefixes every command with --no-lazy-fetch, and attribute_state first checks governing working/index .gitattributes sources explicitly, including promised blob availability. prior_findings.COMPARISON-2: Static repair present: effective four conversion attributes plus core.autocrlf are fingerprinted; local verification and the exclusive remote index transaction recheck them before and after alternate-index apply. core.filemode and core.symlinks are captured/rechecked too.
prior_findings.core.symlinks=false: Static repair present: physical regular target-text bytes remain in work_raw while semantic working version retains indexed120000. Configuration drift is part of local/remote stale verification. New author regression compares actual Git add result.

assessment: HEAD/index/work snapshots are raw, bounded and immutable. Full serialized index stamp detects flags/extensions that ls-files does not expose. Local and remote transactions preserve existing index.lock, operate on an alternate index, recheck before installation and leave working bytes alone.

Paths go through literal Git pathspecs or quoted patch/script arguments. Read-only migration/matrix preserve raw non-UTF8 keys; the working lens refuses unrepresentable/unsafe paths and does not traverse parent symlinks. Binary/non-UTF8 content, submodules, unreadable paths and conversions cannot trigger lens staging.

UI line actions bind to data_request and frozen snapshot, reject loading/closed/refreshed/reopened states, and revalidate actual repository state before writing. Profile reload drops state; nested comparison jobs capture initiating connection context via connections::spawn.

Local repository Git calls use Practice-aware repository_command before profile selection, including alternate index writes. Raw diff alignment uses owned scratch files with GIT environment cleared, empty global config and external diff/textconv disabled.

Matrix resolves each selected branch once to a commit and uses immutable tree/blob OIDs; file presence, modes and shared blob markers remain distinct. Migration pins commits/ranges or verifies staged HEAD/index snapshots and presents rename/copy metadata separately from raw content edits.

Existing new tests meaningfully cover missing root/nested promised attributes with trace and object availability checks; remote after-apply attribute drift; native symlink emulation; actual UI actions; stale index flags/HEAD/work; Practice with hostile profile and environment. No source edits were made by reviewer.
